lineage: Huntress found the 2024 locker derived from leaked LockBit (late-2022) code; other researchers describe a post-Conti, centralised (non-RaaS) operation with a newer custom locker
summary: SafePay emerged in late 2024 and grew rapidly in 2025 as a centrally run (non-affiliate) extortion crew attributed to former Conti-ecosystem members. Access comes through RDP/VPN with valid or weak credentials (including firewall misconfigurations that bypassed VPN MFA) and, in 2025, email bombing followed by Microsoft Teams calls from a fake IT department to obtain Quick Assist sessions. Operators disable Defender, map shares with PowerView ShareFinder, archive data with WinRAR and exfiltrate via FileZilla or rclone, then launch a DLL locker with regsvr32 after a likely CMSTPLUA UAC bypass, encrypting network shares over UNC paths within roughly a day.
